name: Activity Timeline
description: Every URLQuery report on one UTC time axis under thimble's time range selector, a lane per data source or per value of the field or label Rows names, with Filter by and Color by in the top row; under the lanes the same lanes as a list, each with its reports over its own span as a sparkline, its count, its first and last report and its mix of the Color by values; a lane chosen opens its episodes, the bursts of its reports less than two hours apart, in a side panel, and a report there opens in full with its source row, provenance and decisions.

records.name: report
records.one: one URLQuery report, a row of all-reports.csv with its row of report-sources.csv and, when its report_id has them, its row of selection-provenance.csv and its decisions

fields.name: time
fields.how: read as UTC to the second

fields.name: lane
fields.from: data_source, or disposition for a report with no source row
fields.how: the data_source joined on report_id, else Review required or Background control

fields.name: data_source
fields.how: the source row with the same report_id, with its source_basis and matched_sources

fields.name: catalog
fields.how: supplemental when its report_id is listed there, else main

fields.name: why_short
fields.how: each stock sentence cut to a few words and the disclaimer on imported tags dropped

records.name: episode
records.one: the reports of one lane whose consecutive times are less than two hours apart

fields.name: start
fields.how: the first report's time, a gap of two hours or more starting the next episode

accepts.means: the report on line <n> of all-reports.csv, report-sources.csv, additional-cited-reports.csv or selection-provenance.csv, or the report of the decision whose lines hold line <n> of a decisions file, opened in full in its lane's episodes
decision <k> of supplement-classifications.json or classification-overrides.json, its report opened in full in its lane's episodes

units.means: one lane's reports, such as unctad, review-required or background-control, the lane opened with its episodes
every report of one UTC day, zoomed to that day
the reports between two UTC times written YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, zoomed to that window
one lane's reports on one UTC day, a bar of the overview, the lane opened and zoomed to that day
one lane's reports between two UTC times, a bar once zoomed in, the lane opened and zoomed to that window
one episode of a lane, named by its first report's UTC second, such as unctad/2026-05-17T00:10:01Z, its lane opened at that episode
